sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: No candidate is a property mapping plating to a requirement/lookup case or validating the Table 8 selection; nltl:plating is a Class and cannot satisfy the missing relationship.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Reject: the COMPLETE contract’s nltl:plating term is omitted, so the cases are not scoped to hull plating. The ship-level asBuiltThickness, materialClass, and steelGrade can also disagree with the corresponding case-level asBuiltPlateThickness, steelMaterialClass, and actualHullStructuralSteelGrade, while the asserted required grade is never validated as the Table 8 selection for the thickness, Polar Class, material class, and strength category. Preserve each property’s declared owner, add canonical paths linking relevant plating to its requirement/lookup case, enforce consistency including the m-to-mm conversion, and validate the Table 8 selection before applying actualRank >= requiredRank. Activate the matcher because the needed plating-to-case and table-selection mapping terms are absent from the scoped vocabulary.
